jobs.description: Amazon's Delivery Service Partner (DSP) program is the backbone of last-mile delivery - thousands of independent small businesses that hire drivers, operate Amazon-branded vans and deliver millions of packages every day across North America, Europe and the rest of the world. The Senior Financial Analyst will serve as the dedicated Finance partner to the WW DSP Payments and Pricing teams within the WW DSP Finance Central Team, reporting to the Senior Finance Manager, and will own two interconnected mandates. On pricing, the role establishes Finance as the governance and analytical partner to the Pricing team - building the rate card audit framework, embedding Finance checkpoints before rate changes are implemented, shaping PRICE tool controllership design, and bridging Pricing and Payments so disconnects are caught before they become payment defects. Both mandates run on an AI-first operating model: extending AI-driven validation agents from weekly variable payments to every recurring control and into EU and ROW, so Finance time shifts from manual approval to exception management, root-cause resolution and strategic partnership. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role for a Finance professional who combines strong controllership instincts and sound judgement on high-dollar decisions with the ability to influence Payments Product, Payment Ops, Pricing, Trans CS and Internal Audit stakeholders - and who operates with equal confidence at the transaction level and in front of senior leadership. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and a culture where every team member is encouraged to ask questions and challenge assumptions. As we look ahead, we are focused on expanding our analytical capabilities and building scalable tools that drive efficiency. If you are curious, resourceful, and excited about growing your career in finance at one of the world's most innovative companies, we would love to hear from you.

Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an AI Deployment Manager (ADM) at SpaceXAI, you’ll own the post-sale journey for a portfolio of enterprise customers, driving adoption, retention, and expansion. You’ll help organizations successfully roll out Grok, Grok Build (Cursor), Grok Bot, and Grok APIs and evolve how they work with AI across knowledge work and coding.

You’ll operate at the center of each account, partnering with developers, admins, and executives while working closely with Sales, Field Engineering, Product, and Support. You’ll shape rollout strategy and influence SpaceXAI’s roadmap priorities through customer insight.

Success is measured by customer retention, product adoption, and revenue expansion.

What you’ll do

- Manage a book of business with our top enterprise customers, owning the long-term success of each account

- Engage CTO / VP / SVP Engineering stakeholders to demonstrate ROI and guide AI-driven organizational change

- Lead enterprise rollouts end-to-end: onboarding, enablement, internal champions, and scaled adoption

- Turn high-impact use cases into durable, repeatable workflows across teams

- Monitor account health and usage data to drive renewals and expansion with AEs

- Represent the customer internally, synthesizing feedback and influencing product priorities

You may be a fit if

- You’ve worked at the intersection of business and technology and thrive in customer-facing roles

- You can translate customer needs into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes

- You understand modern engineering and knowledge-work orgs, the SDLC, developer and knowledge-worker workflows, and tool adoption

- You communicate comfortably with multiple functions around an enterprise including developers and senior executives

- You’re analytical and operational, using data to prioritize and drive action

- You’re already a power user of Grok, Grok Build (Cursor), Grok Bot, or Grok APIs (or modern AI tools for knowledge work and coding) with strong opinions about what great looks like (big plus)

- Speak fluent Japanese and business level English
